project_type: Next.js 16 React 19 app (CFA exam prep tool)
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run tsc --noEmit (must pass). 2. Run bun run vitest --run (pre-existing env.test.ts failure is acceptable). 3. Verify formula count >= 120 by checking formulaSeed.length in the data file.
setup_instructions: Already set up. bun is at /root/.local/share/mise/shims/bun.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no external npm installs. All dependencies already installed. Cannot run next build (needs network). Use tsc --noEmit for type checking.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (extract to src/shared/). No TODOs, no placeholders. Use CSS variables for theming (--accent-primary, --accent-secondary, --card-bg, --card-border). Critical React rule: NEVER use useSyncExternalStore, use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer for localStorage reads.
key_patterns: FormulaEntry type: { id, name, subject, reading, formula, variables, example }. Subjects config at src/shared/config/subjects.ts. CSS uses inline styles with CSS variables. Components use lucide-react icons. sortByCfaOrder() sorts subjects.
directory_structure: src/features/formulas/data/ (formula data), src/features/formulas/components/ (UI components), src/shared/config/ (subjects.ts, navigation.ts), src/app/(protected)/formulas/ (page route)
